description: Defines the ParsedCertificate class representing an X.509 certificate, including methods for creation, accessors for certificate fields, and extension handling within the Chromium project.

classes.name: ParsedCertificate
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate with parsing and extension access methods.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a ParsedCertificate from DER-encoded data, returning nullptr on failure.

methods.name: CreateAndAddToVector
methods.description: Creates a ParsedCertificate and appends it to a chain vector.

methods.name: der_cert
methods.description: Returns the DER-encoded certificate data.

methods.name: signature_algorithm
methods.description: Returns the signature algorithm used in the certificate, if known.

methods.name: has_basic_constraints
methods.description: Checks if BasicConstraints extension is present.

methods.name: basic_constraints
methods.description: Returns the BasicConstraints extension data.

methods.name: has_key_usage
methods.description: Checks if KeyUsage extension is present.

methods.name: key_usage
methods.description: Returns the KeyUsage BitString.

methods.name: has_extended_key_usage
methods.description: Checks if ExtendedKeyUsage extension is present.

methods.name: extended_key_usage
methods.description: Returns the ExtendedKeyUsage OIDs.

methods.name: has_subject_alt_names
methods.description: Checks if SubjectAltName extension is present.

methods.name: subject_alt_names_extension
methods.description: Returns the ParsedExtension for SubjectAltName.

methods.name: subject_alt_names
methods.description: Returns parsed GeneralNames from SubjectAltName.

methods.name: has_name_constraints
methods.description: Checks if NameConstraints extension is present.

methods.name: name_constraints
methods.description: Returns the NameConstraints extension data.

methods.name: has_authority_info_access
methods.description: Checks if AuthorityInfoAccess extension is present.

methods.name: authority_info_access_extension
methods.description: Returns the ParsedExtension for AuthorityInfoAccess.

methods.name: ca_issuers_uris
methods.description: Returns CA Issuers URIs from AuthorityInfoAccess.

methods.name: ocsp_uris
methods.description: Returns OCSP URIs from AuthorityInfoAccess.

methods.name: has_policy_oids
methods.description: Checks if Policies extension is present.

methods.name: policy_oids
methods.description: Returns policy OIDs.

methods.name: has_policy_constraints
methods.description: Checks if PolicyConstraints extension is present.

methods.name: policy_constraints
methods.description: Returns PolicyConstraints data.

methods.name: has_policy_mappings
methods.description: Checks if PolicyMappings extension is present.

methods.name: policy_mappings
methods.description: Returns PolicyMappings data.

methods.name: has_inhibit_any_policy
methods.description: Checks if InhibitAnyPolicy extension is present.

methods.name: inhibit_any_policy
methods.description: Returns the InhibitAnyPolicy value.

methods.name: authority_key_identifier
methods.description: Returns AuthorityKeyIdentifier extension if present.

methods.name: subject_key_identifier
methods.description: Returns SubjectKeyIdentifier extension if present.

methods.name: GetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a specific extension by OID.
